```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  claude-review:
    if: ${{ contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install anthropic requests

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          COMMENT_ID: ${{ github.event.comment.id }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.pull_request && github.event.issue.number || '' }}
          COMMENT_BODY: ${{ github.event.comment.body }}
          COMMENT_AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.comment.user.login }}
        run: |
          python - << 'EOF'
          import os
          import json
          import requests
          from anthropic import Anthropic

          # Configuration
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = os.environ['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY']
          GITHUB_TOKEN = os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN']
          COMMENT_ID = int(os.environ['COMMENT_ID'])
          REPO = os.environ['REPO']
          ISSUE_NUMBER = int(os.environ['ISSUE_NUMBER'])
          PR_NUMBER = os.environ.get('PR_NUMBER')
          COMMENT_BODY = os.environ['COMMENT_BODY']
          COMMENT_AUTHOR = os.environ['COMMENT_AUTHOR']

          # Initialize Anthropic client
          client = Anthropic(api_key=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

          # GitHub API headers
          headers = {
              'Authorization': f'token {GITHUB_TOKEN}',
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'
          }

          # Determine if this is a PR or Issue
          is_pr = PR_NUMBER != ''
          number = int(PR_NUMBER) if is_pr else ISSUE_NUMBER
          endpoint = 'pulls' if is_pr else 'issues'

          # Get the PR or Issue details
          response = requests.get(
              f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/{endpoint}/{number}',
              headers=headers
          )
          pr_or_issue = response.json()

          # If it's a PR, get the diff
          if is_pr:
              diff_response = requests.get(
                  f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/pulls/{number}/diff',
                  headers=headers
              )
              diff_content = diff_response.text[:100000]  # Limit diff size
          else:
              diff_content = "This is an issue, not a pull request."

          # Get all comments on the PR or Issue
          comments_response = requests.get(
              f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/{endpoint}/{number}/comments',
              headers=headers
          )
          comments = comments_response.json()
          comments_text = "\n".join([f"{c['user']['login']}: {c['body']}" for c in comments])

          # Construct the prompt for Claude
          prompt = f"""
          You are Claude, an AI assistant helping with code review and issue discussion.
          
          Repository: {REPO}
          {'Pull Request' if is_pr else 'Issue'} #{number}: {pr_or_issue['title']}
          Author: {pr_or_issue['user']['login']}
          
          {'Pull Request Diff:' if is_pr else 'Issue Description:'}
          {diff_content if is_pr else pr_or_issue['body']}
          
          Previous Comments:
          {comments_text}
          
          The user @COMMENT_AUTHOR mentioned you with the following request:
          {COMMENT_BODY}
          
          Please provide a helpful, concise response addressing the user's request.
          If this is a PR, focus on code quality, potential issues, and improvements.
          If this is an issue, help clarify or solve the problem described.
          """

          # Call Claude API
          message = client.messages.create(
              model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
              max_tokens=1024,
              messages=[
                  {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
              ]
          )

          claude_response = message.content[0].text

          # Post the response as a comment
          response = requests.post(
              f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/{endpoint}/{number}/comments',
              headers=headers,
              json={'body': claude_response}
          )

          if response.status_code == 201:
              print("Successfully posted Claude's response.")
          else:
              print(f"Failed to post response: {response.status_code} {response.text}")
          EOF
```
